v1_1_0.new_0: Audio metadata: title, artist, album and duration read directly from files (MP3, FLAC, WAV, OGG, M4A, Opus)
v1_1_0.new_1: Album art YouTube Music style — full image on the card, title below, duration overlaid
v1_1_0.new_2: Stronger text shadows on light artwork for optimal readability
v1_1_0.new_4: Release notes popup on every new version (you're reading the first one!)
v1_1_0.perf_0: Rust batch loading (rayon) — all metadata read in parallel in a single IPC call
v1_1_0.perf_1: Artwork loaded on demand via IntersectionObserver (200 px margin) — no more UI blocking
v1_1_0.perf_2: Concurrency limiter: max 4 simultaneous artwork requests
v1_1_0.perf_3: Progress bar while metadata is being analysed
v1_1_0.perf_4: Session cache with 300 entries (FIFO eviction) to avoid re-reads
v1_1_0.fix_1: lofty probe chain fixed (LoftyError / io::Error type mismatch)

v1_0_51.new_0: Built-in dialogs (prompt, confirm) replacing native browser alerts
v1_0_51.new_1: Toast notification system for action feedback
v1_0_51.new_2: Update banner at the bottom of the screen with download progress
v1_0_51.new_3: Persistent mini-player with artwork, artist and volume control
v1_0_51.new_4: Music folders: customisable colour via right-click
v1_0_51.new_5: Drag and drop tracks between folders
v1_0_51.change_0: Track duration cache survives page navigation
v1_0_51.change_1: Sort tracks by name, duration or extension with configurable direction

v1_0_0.new_0: Game library with automatic Steam, Epic Games and Battle.net scanning
v1_0_0.new_1: Built-in music player with folder tree navigation
v1_0_0.new_3: Customisable background image and accent colour
v1_0_0.new_5: Background mode (system tray) when closing the window
